originality: All banks, eligibility/assignment/power inputs, calculations, copyable code, hypothetical PAP, p-values, contingencies and exercises original synthetic teaching material. No empirical or registry action performed.
conceptual_boundary: Power is exact only for the stated known-variance independent-normal planning law. Implemented estimated-variance inference in PAP is expressly asymptotic; actual-test finite-sample performance requires further study-specific work. No known real variance, study approval or power guarantee.
